Save settings for this repo (stored in ~/.proof/config.json).

```sh
proof init [--json] [--scheme <scheme>] [--workspace <workspace>] [--project <project>] [--test-plan <test-plan>] [--simulator <simulator>] [--bundle-id <bundle-id>] [--trunk <trunk>] [--prepare <prepare>] [--show] [--forget]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--scheme <scheme>` | Scheme to build and test. |
| `--workspace <workspace>` | Workspace path relative to the repo root. |
| `--project <project>` | Project path relative to the repo root. |
| `--test-plan <test-plan>` | Test plan name. |
| `--simulator <simulator>` | Simulator name or UDID, e.g. "iPhone 16". |
| `--bundle-id <bundle-id>` | Bundle identifier of the app under test. |
| `--trunk <trunk>` | Branch your stacks start from (default: the repo's default branch, e.g. main or develop). |
| `--prepare <prepare>` | Shell command to run in a checkout before building, e.g. "tuist generate". |
| `--show` | Print the current config only. |
| `--forget` | Remove this repo from proof (keeps its sessions and flows). |

**JSON output** (`--json`):

- [`MessageReport`](../../json-output/#messagereport)
